page.overview:
Who is King Nail?

King Nail is a recurring antagonist of the video games based on the 2003 animated series.

King Nail is fought at the end of the Notes from the Underground stage. He is found in a stasis tube, and when the approach it, he breaks free and attacks. After being defeated, he dissolves into a yellow-green cloud.

King Nail is a common enemy instead of a boss and appears during Michelangelo levels.

King Nail is fought at the end of Episode 1-2, Secret Hall, right after the Turtles face . King Nail has most of the same techniques as he did when they first fought him, but he has lost the ability to fly.
